TITLE — typeset this exact headline, large, high-contrast, in the vertical middle 60% of the frame. No other words, no byline, no watermark, no logo:
Threat-model your rollback: the migration downgrade nobody tested until 2am

SUBJECT
Every migration ships two functions and you only run one. Reproduce the untested-downgrade incident on a throwaway Postgres, then three ranked fixes.

NOTES
Somebody, right now, has a function they have never run. It's most of you. I threat model this instead of sleeping. Here is the scenario I lie awake on. It is 2am. A deploy has gone wrong in a way that is not the migration's fault — a bad config, a poisoned cache, the moon — and the runbook says the same thing runbooks always say: roll back . So you type with the shaky confidence of a person who has never once watched this command succeed, and one of two things happens. Either raises — because i

ART DIRECTION

Draw the concrete apparatus this article is about — not a generic circuit board, robot, brain, or rocket. No faces. No UI chrome. No stock-tech collage. The still frame must read at 300px.
